reframe: Two capabilities: (1) hard-to-fool = BUILT; (2) good-at-finding-opportunity = UNPROVEN. Next chapter tests capability 2 efficiently via observability+construction, not more directional mining. Not attached to the architecture.

checkpoints.question: Did we unlock materially new observability (option/vol-structure class acquired + tested)?
checkpoints.miss_branch: Acquisition decision has been frozen too long -> force invest-or-abandon on that branch.

checkpoints.question: ≥1 additional portfolio-improving component graduated OR observability class decisively retired?
checkpoints.miss_branch: 'Accessible-edges' thesis is failing -> begin explicit universe/horizon/return-target change, not more mining.

checkpoints.question: Has the process repeatedly generated candidates surviving rigorous validation (≥3 independent survivors)?
checkpoints.miss_branch: Current data/markets/research-model is the wrong vehicle -> change course. Sunk cost is not a reason to continue.

change_20pct: source from advantage not arbitraged literature
